messages:
Ben (Account Exec): kicking off a quick preflight for the Cypherlane POC — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM user/group sync, and fine-grained RBAC. timeline: 2-week POC. Can SE/security confirm blockers?
Maya (Solutions Eng): got it. quick qs: 1) Will they require SCIM write access to groups AND users? 2) Any requirement for SCIM rate limits or delta-only sync? 3) Which IdP (Okta/AzureAD/OneLogin)?
Ben (Account Exec): customer said Okta primary, maybe AzureAD later. they want group-based roles and domain isolation for multiple subdomains. SCIM write to users+groups preferred.
Rae (Security Eng): main security asks: do they need PV (provable deletion) and org-level KMS? Also need to know if any EU-only data residency required. we should queue the security questionnaire items: subprocessors, SOC2 date, penetration test cadence, KMS/HSM options.
Samir (Product): for RBAC at group scale (20k users, ~200 groups), recommend Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput during bulk sync, also avoids noisy-neighbor rate throttles. pricing impact: Dedicated monthly commit vs hosted per-token/requests — sales should flag for quote.
Maya (Solutions Eng): operational playbook for POC: 1) Provide a test Okta tenant (svc account) 2) We'll create a staging org in Redwood Private (short-lived) 3) Run initial SCIM full sync, then do delta syncs. can Ben get Okta admin creds (svc) or at least an admin invite?
Ben (Account Exec): customer can create a scoped Okta svc account; will share creds via 1Password; legal ok with temporary staging.
Maya (Solutions Eng): SCIM sample PATCH we'll run for group mapping:
```json
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id}
{
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"00u1abc","display":"alice@cypherlane.com"}]}
  ]
}
```
Maya (Solutions Eng): note: we'll need write access to manage group membership and to read user schemas for custom attributes (e.g., employeeType -> role).
Rae (Security Eng): confirm: customer wants RBAC mapping to SAML attributes or to SCIM groups? Which one is their source of truth? we need to record this for audit.
Ben (Account Exec): they said groups as source of truth, with SAML attribute fallback for external partners.
Samir (Product): also add: for domain isolation (multi-tenant within one Okta org) we can support per-domain ACLs; need to verify their domain proofing plan and whether they require tenant-level cert rotation.
Maya (Solutions Eng): POC acceptance criteria proposal: 1) initial full SCIM sync finishes without errors within 4 hours 2) group membership changes propagate within 30s for <100 concurrent changes 3) RBAC enforced for three sample apps via SAML/roles 4) no data left after staging teardown (provable deletion).
Rae (Security Eng): I'll attach the checklist items for the security questionnaire. ask: do they require a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) flow? if yes, we need SRE + product signoff for Private/KMS integration.
infra-bot: staging org provisioned: org-id=rwd-stg-cypherlane, created by maya at 1765239999, region=us-west-2
Maya (Solutions Eng): thanks infra-bot. I'll kick off initial full sync tomorrow CET morning. Ben — please share Okta svc access and the security questionnaire answers.
Ben (Account Exec): will do by EOD. pinging @Rae for any immediate blockers. :thumbsup:
Rae (Security Eng): no blockers from security side yet, please send the completed questionnaire. Also include required SLAs for Dedicated if they ask.
Samir (Product): FYI pricing note: if they want group sync every 5s, we need a custom throughput tier — call out in quote.
Maya (Solutions Eng): one more ops note: if they hit SCIM 429s, we'll fallback to incremental queuing and report metrics in Console. include that in POC runbook.
Ben (Account Exec): perfect. I'll compile quote options (hosted vs dedicated) and close the loop once creds and questionnaire arrive.
Maya (Solutions Eng): great, will schedule the POC kick tomorrow after creds arrive.
Rae (Security Eng): added a line item: legal needs subprocessors list and ISO/SOC docs before any data import.
Ben (Account Exec): noted — I'll attach SOC2 link and subprocessors doc in thread.
Maya (Solutions Eng): all set on my side for now. :rocket:
